story.theme_rule: In this world, every child is born with skin made of a specific metal, except for Eli who has skin made of rubber.
story.logline: Eli wants to be strong like the metal kids, but when a giant magnet traps the city, he must use his non-magnetic skin to save everyone.

characters.name: Eli
characters.want: to be respected like the metal-skinned kids

characters.name: Mason
characters.want: to show off his steel strength

characters.name: Doctor
characters.want: to shut down a failing machine

clue.text: Eli gets his rubber hands stuck to a wall because they are too grippy.

twist.text: The massive magnet in the lab has no effect on Eli because rubber is non-magnetic.

story.ending: Eli is no longer laughed at because his rubber skin was the only thing that could stop the magnetic storm.

source: Gemini writer, format bank: Special power world

lines.text: In this world, Eli is the only kid whose skin isn’t made of hard metal, so why is he the only one running toward the city’s giant magnet?
lines.say: (serious) In this world, Eli is the only kid whose skin isn’t made of hard metal, so why is he the only one running toward the city’s giant magnet?
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli stands in a crowded city square where every other kid has shiny silver or copper skin.

lines.text: While the other kids show off their heavy steel arms and iron legs, Eli’s body is made of soft, bouncy rubber.
lines.say: (soft tone) While the other kids show off their heavy steel arms and iron legs, Eli’s body is made of soft, bouncy rubber.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Mason flexes his metallic bicep while Eli stands nearby looking at his own soft, flexible arm.

lines.text: Eli tries to climb a building to prove he is strong, but his rubber hands are so grippy that he gets stuck to the side of a shop.
lines.say: (nervous) Eli tries to climb a building to prove he is strong, but his rubber hands are so grippy that he gets stuck to the side of a shop.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli is stuck halfway up a wall, his palms pressed flat against the surface, unable to pull them away.

lines.text: Mason laughs and points a heavy iron finger, calling Eli a useless toy that will never be a real hero.
lines.say: (angry) Mason laughs and points a heavy iron finger, calling Eli a useless toy that will never be a real hero.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: On the street below, Mason and a crowd of metal kids laugh while looking up at the stuck Eli.

lines.text: Suddenly, a massive experimental magnet at the city lab malfunctions, sending a blue energy wave through the streets.
lines.say: (worried) Suddenly, a massive experimental magnet at the city lab malfunctions, sending a blue energy wave through the streets.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: The lab in the distance starts sparking with electricity and a blue glow fills the air.

lines.text: The pulse is so strong that every metal-skinned person is pulled toward the lab like they are weightless beads.
lines.say: (nervous) The pulse is so strong that every metal-skinned person is pulled toward the lab like they are weightless beads.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Mason and the other kids are suddenly lifted off the ground and dragged toward the lab building by an invisible force.

lines.text: Eli sees Mason pinned against the lab’s outer wall by the magnetic force, so he decides to jump into the storm to help.
lines.say: (confident) Eli sees Mason pinned against the lab’s outer wall by the magnetic force, so he decides to jump into the storm to help.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli pulls his hands free from the shop wall and runs toward the sparking lab building.

lines.text: As Eli crosses the threshold into the lab, the giant magnet has absolutely no effect on his body.
lines.say: (confident) As Eli crosses the threshold into the lab, the giant magnet has absolutely no effect on his body.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli walks calmly through the center of the magnetic storm while metal objects fly past him.

lines.text: Eli realizes that his rubber skin is the only thing in the city that isn't magnetic, allowing him to move freely.
lines.say: (happy) Eli realizes that his rubber skin is the only thing in the city that isn't magnetic, allowing him to move freely.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli looks at his own hands while standing right in front of the massive glowing magnet core.

lines.text: He uses his sticky, grippy hands to walk straight up the side of the machine to reach the manual shut-off lever.
lines.say: (serious) He uses his sticky, grippy hands to walk straight up the side of the machine to reach the manual shut-off lever.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli is on the side of the giant machine, using his hands to grip the metal casing as he reaches for a handle.

lines.text: Eli pulls the lever, the magnet shuts down, and Mason falls to the ground, looking up in total disbelief.
lines.say: (happy) Eli pulls the lever, the magnet shuts down, and Mason falls to the ground, looking up in total disbelief.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli pulls a giant handle and the blue glow fades; Mason sits on the floor of the lab looking stunned.

lines.text: In this world, Eli is the only kid whose skin isn’t made of hard metal, and today, that made him the strongest of all.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, Eli is the only kid whose skin isn’t made of hard metal, and today, that made him the strongest of all.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.scene: Eli stands in the city square with Mason and the other kids, who are all cheering for him.

upload.title: The Boy with Rubber Skin #Shorts
upload.description:
